palette: charcoal iron blue-grey, slate steel, fog mist, paper cream, amber seal gold, plum ribbon, graphite ink
typography: scale-hall headings on slate rail tabs, paper chips and amber wax verdicts
composition: a public scale hall where a goods token passes four acquisition gates, a two-year window governs the lost-property lane, and three remedy lanes carry money chips from the disposer to the owner
surface: paper files, slate desk rails, fog mist tags, amber wax seals
motion: the disposal token is weighed at each gate and bounces off failed conditions, the lost-property claim arrow stretches inside the two-year window then the acquisition stamp falls after expiry, and remedy chips travel three lanes with their amounts before the owner picks one
transition: the charcoal hall floor, slate rails and amber seal posts persist while gates, window and lanes are re-dressed between scenes
